summary: WS3 Projects horizontal-scroll pin fully meets the plan. Section pins a static track via a single GSAP ScrollTrigger (pin:true, scrub:1) translating x to -(scrollWidth-innerWidth); gsap.matchMedia() gates the pin to (min-width:768px)+no-preference with a vertical stacked-card fallback below; per-slide scale/opacity entrance + bottom progress rail driven by horizontal progress; cleanup via matchMedia teardown + gsap.context().revert(). Mid-scroll screenshot shows real horizontal offset (Admin Dashboard centred, neighbours clipped). tsc clean. Only GSAP pin; pinned subtree never re-renders.
feedback: Minor: per-slide onUpdate gsap.set runs every frame for every slide; a quickSetter would be marginally cheaper (defer to WS5).
Edge case: amount() returns 0 if track.scrollWidth <= innerWidth (very wide viewport, few cards) -> end becomes +=0 and pin collapses; add a min scroll distance guard (defer to WS5).
